instruction:

1. yarn test:typecheck:
excalidraw-app/tests/pages.collab.test.tsx(67,8): error TS2322: Type '{ pageId: string; id: string; x: number; y: number; strokeColor: string; backgroundColor: string; fillStyle: FillStyle; strokeWidth: number; strokeStyle: StrokeStyle; ... 19 more ...; type: "selection"; } | { ...; } | { ...; } | { ...; }' is not assignable to type 'OrderedExcalidrawElement'.
  Type '{ pageId: string; id: string; x: number; y: number; strokeColor: string; backgroundColor: string; fillStyle: FillStyle; strokeWidth: number; strokeStyle: StrokeStyle; ... 19 more ...; type: "selection"; }' is not assignable to type 'OrderedExcalidrawElement'.
    Type '{ pageId: string; id: string; x: number; y: number; strokeColor: string; backgroundColor: string; fillStyle: FillStyle; strokeWidth: number; strokeStyle: StrokeStyle; ... 19 more ...; type: "selection"; }' is not assignable to type 'Readonly<{ id: string; x: number; y: number; strokeColor: string; backgroundColor: string; fillStyle: FillStyle; strokeWidth: number; strokeStyle: StrokeStyle; roundness: { ...; } | null; ... 18 more ...; customData?: Record<...> | undefined; }> & { ...; } 
      Type '{ pageId: string; id: string; x: number; y: number; strokeColor: string; backgroundColor: string; fillStyle: FillStyle; strokeWidth: number; strokeStyle: StrokeStyle; ... 19 more ...; type: "selection"; }' is not assignable to type '{ index: FractionalIndex; }'.
        Types of property 'index' are incompatible.
The element built around line 67 spreads a union of element types that includes type "selection" into a place that does not accept it. Build test elements with API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", ... }) (packages/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api) or newElement({ type: "rectangle", ... }) and add pageId with a typed spread, e.g. { ...rect, pageId: "page-2" } as ExcalidrawElement typed to the concrete element, so the file passes tsc. Keep every test case and its assertions as they are.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "excalidraw-app/tests/pages.collab.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "excalidraw-app/tests/pages.collab.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
